name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Nampa ID

fieldNotes._status: CONSTRUCTION-ERA. Tractor Supply broke ground 2025-04-22 on its 11th DC (865,000 sq ft, ~$225M, 500+ jobs, internal codename 'Project Spud') at the NE corner of Ustick Rd and Midland Blvd, 9640 Ustick Rd, Nampa ID. Target ops late 2026/early 2027. Maxar 2026 satellite shows only early earthwork: a graded oval pad, construction trailers, concrete tilt-up forms, pipe/material stockpiles, a temporary water-treatment pond, and a perimeter haul road. The Aug-2025 Street View caught the very start of tilt-up concrete wall panels being erected along the SW edge.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate exists yet. truckGate ring is the PLANNED/most-likely truck entrance off the new N-S collector road on the west edge; not yet built or controlled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth present in any imagery; site has no built entrance structure yet.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Building shell not yet erected; only partial tilt-up wall panels visible Aug-2025. No dock doors countable. Final DC will have a large dock bank (50+) once built.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No striped trailer parking yet; site is graded dirt.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Planned DC will almost certainly have a large drop yard given its 865k sq ft scale and PNW hub role serving 200+ stores, but none exists in current imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 0 completed buildings; only construction trailers and partial wall panels. Note: a separate completed warehouse (likely an Amazon facility) sits ~700m SE and is NOT this site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town greenfield surrounded by farmland on Nampa's NW fringe; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 54.9 ac measured over the visibly graded development parcel; the full assembled site is larger (~150+ ac with future 150k sq ft expansion pad).
fieldNotes.perimeter: Traced to the graded development parcel, square to the orthogonal Ustick(N)/collector-road(W) grid. Exact fenced boundary not yet established on the ground.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Both panos are real Aug-2025 captures on the public roads bordering the parcel (perimeter pano on east-edge road; gate pano on Ustick near the NW roundabout/collector entrance).
